biotools.summary: Eddymotion is an open-source framework for volume-to-volume artifact estimation in neuroimaging, inspired by FSL’s eddy. It offers an alternative to FSL's eddy without commercial limitations and generalizes beyond eddy current distortions of diffusion MRI.
biotools.name: eddymotion
